package assistance

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

type IDGenerator interface {
	NewID() string
}

type Clock interface {
	Now() time.Time
}

type RecordInput struct {
	PersonalTeacherID string
	StudentID         string
	CorrelationID     string
	CausationID       string
	LearningActionID  string
	ContextType       domain.LearningContextType
	ContextID         string
	SupportContext    domain.TeacherSupportContext
	HintsUsed         int
	MaxHintLevel      *int
	InterventionUsed  bool
	Observations      []domain.TeacherAssistanceObservation
	PolicyVersion     string
}

type Record struct {
	Assistance repository.LearningActionAssistance
	IDs        IDGenerator
	Clock      Clock
}

func (useCase Record) Execute(ctx context.Context, input RecordInput) (domain.LearningActionAssistance, error) {
	if useCase.Assistance == nil || useCase.IDs == nil || useCase.Clock == nil {
		return domain.LearningActionAssistance{}, errors.New("invalid record learning action assistance use case")
	}
	value, err := domain.NewLearningActionAssistance(domain.LearningActionAssistance{
		ID:                useCase.IDs.NewID(),
		PersonalTeacherID: input.PersonalTeacherID,
		StudentID:         input.StudentID,
		CorrelationID:     input.CorrelationID,
		CausationID:       input.CausationID,
		LearningActionID:  input.LearningActionID,
		ContextType:       input.ContextType,
		ContextID:         input.ContextID,
		SupportContext:    input.SupportContext,
		HintsUsed:         input.HintsUsed,
		MaxHintLevel:      input.MaxHintLevel,
		InterventionUsed:  input.InterventionUsed,
		Observations:      input.Observations,
		PolicyVersion:     input.PolicyVersion,
		CreatedAt:         useCase.Clock.Now(),
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningActionAssistance{}, err
	}
	event, err := domain.NewIntegrationEvent(
		useCase.IDs.NewID(),
		domain.SubjectTeacherAssistanceObserved,
		value.CorrelationID,
		value.CausationID,
		value.StudentID,
		value.CreatedAt,
		domain.TeacherAssistanceObservedSchemaVersion,
		value.EventData(),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningActionAssistance{}, err
	}
	if err := useCase.Assistance.Record(ctx, value, event); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningActionAssistance{}, err
	}
	return value, nil
}
